title: Recording date and Floyd Jackson, who stayed in the country
summary: Allen states the date, January 18, 1962, and the interviewers; Floyd Jackson is described as a good musician who never played in the city and is still living.

blocks.x: That's right. Let me put the date on here. This is January the 18th, 1962. My name is Dick Allen. And the other interviewer is Bill Russell. That was a good musician too. Floyd Jackson. Very good.
Did he play much around the city here, Floyd Jackson? Never. Never played here. Stayed in the country. Still here. He's still here. He's still here. He's still here.
